value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for two canonical order-parity subfamilies of induced connected subpaths. The even-parity class exhibits a precise Gaussian-norm/prime-factor arithmetic obstruction with exact binomial nullity at every size; the odd-parity class has a contrasting modulo-four law. These answer a well-defined Fourier identifiability question beyond the ordinary subtree count, without claiming extension to general trees or a larger theorem.
